name: Labs64 NetLicensing
description: Access the official Labs64 NetLicensing REST API for products, product modules, license templates, licensees, licenses, bundles, transactions, tokens, payment methods, and utility metadata.

authentication.name: Basic Authentication
authentication.description: Authenticate NetLicensing REST requests with HTTP Basic auth. Use the fixed username `apiKey` and your NetLicensing API key as the password.

setupGuide.title: Set up Labs64 NetLicensing credentials
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need a NetLicensing API key with the role required for the operations you want to run.

steps.title: Open the NetLicensing API key settings
steps.description: Sign in to the NetLicensing Management Console and open Settings > API Keys.

steps.title: Choose the API key for this connection
steps.description: For full CRUD coverage, use an Admin API key. MindCloud stores the literal username `apiKey` in the Username field and your selected NetLicensing API key in the Password field.

steps.title: Enter the credentials in MindCloud
steps.description: Set Username to `apiKey` and set Password to the NetLicensing API key value. Leave other fields empty.

name: LabsMobile
description: Send SMS messages, check account balance, and manage messaging operations through LabsMobile's SMS API.

authentication.name: Basic Auth
authentication.description: Use your LabsMobile account email as the username and your generated API token as the password.

setupGuide.title: Connect LabsMobile with Basic Auth
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need the LabsMobile account email used for API access and a generated API token from LabsMobile's API configuration page.

steps.title: Use the LabsMobile API username
steps.description: Enter the LabsMobile account email that is authorized for API access in the Username field for this connection.

steps.title: Use the generated API token as the password
steps.description: Generate or copy the API token from LabsMobile's API configuration page and enter it in the Password field. Do not add a Basic prefix or other formatting.

steps.title: Save and test the connection
steps.description: After you fill in Username and Password, save the connection and run the Get Balance connection test action. LabsMobile should authorize the request and return the account balance.

name: Leadspicker

authentication.name: API Key

authentication.name: Access Token
authentication.description: Use a LightwaveRF bearer access token from Settings > API Integration > Get Token.
authentication.notes: LightwaveRF public API requests use a bearer access token. Official public API docs require the token to include the lwpublic scope. Refresh-token docs require a basic token in addition to the refresh token, so this connector expects users to replace the access token manually when it expires.

steps.title: Confirm your password
steps.description: When Lightwave prompts for your Link Plus account password, enter it to reveal your API tokens.

steps.title: Copy the bearer token
steps.description: Copy the bearer access token from Lightwave and paste it into the Cirra Access Token field for this connection.

name: Linkila
description: Create, manage, and analyze Linkila short links, domains, filters, redirection sessions, and access logs through the Linkila Public API v1.

authentication.name: API Key
authentication.description: Authenticate to Linkila Public API v1 with a bearer API key.
authentication.notes: Linkila's official OpenAPI document declares HTTP bearer ApiKeyAuth with bearerFormat APIKey. Stage 0 signup is currently blocked by Cloudflare Turnstile, so a human must obtain the API key before runtime testing.

setupGuide.title: Connect Linkila with an API key
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need a Linkila account and a provider-native Linkila API key. Stage 0 found that headless signup is blocked by Cloudflare Turnstile, so complete signup or login in a human-controlled browser first.

steps.title: Sign in to Linkila
steps.description: Open https://app.linkila.com/auth/ and sign in or create a Linkila account with apps@mindcloud.co. Solve Cloudflare Turnstile in a human-controlled browser if prompted.

steps.title: Find the API key settings
steps.description: After authentication, open Linkila's API, integrations, developer, or API-key settings. The exact in-app settings URL was not reachable during Stage 0 because signup was blocked.

steps.title: Create or copy the provider-native API key
steps.description: Create or copy a Linkila API key that works with the Linkila Public API v1. Do not use any Zapier-only or integration-scoped key if one is presented.

steps.title: Paste the key into MindCloud
steps.description: Paste the key into the MindCloud API Key field. MindCloud sends it as an Authorization Bearer token.

steps.title: Create a new Personal Access Token
steps.description: Create a PAT and include every scope required by the LiveChat actions you want to use. For this wrapper's frozen action set, that includes chat read/write scopes, customer read/write scopes, and routing-status scopes. The docs note that you cannot change PAT scopes after the token is created.

steps.title: Use your LiveChat account ID as the username

steps.title: Enter the credentials in MindCloud
steps.description: Paste your LiveChat account ID into the Username field and your PAT into the Password field. MindCloud will generate the Basic Authorization header automatically, so you do not need to paste a pre-encoded base64 string into the form.

name: Livestorm

authentication.name: API Key
authentication.description: Use a Livestorm Public API token. Livestorm requires a validated workspace with Public API access enabled before tokens can be generated.

setupGuide.title: Get a Livestorm API token
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need a Livestorm workspace where Public API access has been enabled. Only workspace owners and admins can create or rotate tokens.

steps.title: Sign in to Livestorm as a workspace owner or admin
steps.description: Use the workspace that will back this MindCloud connection.

steps.title: Enable Public API access if the Public API panel is missing
steps.description: If your workspace has not been validated for API access yet, contact Livestorm support and ask them to enable Public API for the workspace.

steps.title: Open Livestorm's API token instructions
steps.description: Follow Livestorm's token guide and go to Public API > Token management.

steps.title: Create a token with the scopes you need
steps.description: For the initial read-only connection, include the scopes needed for events and people reads. Add write scopes only when you intentionally want live mutation support later.

steps.title: Paste the token into MindCloud
steps.description: Use the copied value as the Livestorm app connection in MindCloud, and save it before leaving Livestorm because the token will not be shown again.

setupGuide.title: Connect Loopy Loyalty

steps.title: Enter your Loopy Loyalty username
steps.description: Use the username of the Loopy Loyalty account or subuser that owns the credentials. The API spec requires this value in the JWT username claim.

steps.title: Save the connection values
steps.description: Paste the API Key, API Secret, and Username into the connection form and save the connection. A later stage will wire these saved values into the JWT request flow.
